{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., < 0.33) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude after sharp upward spikes in price (e.g., > 70) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when recent prices are trending downward (sentiment < 0.33).",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is > 10% above forecast at day 10+ of horizon, adjust downward by 2-5% per day.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.67+ positivity, increase forecast volatility ceiling to avoid underestimating bullish momentum.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, apply a 3-5% downward bias if true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by > 5% over 3 consecutive days."
  ]
}
